faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about KAMBRIQ and our services.

items.a: KAMBRIQ is a land strategy advisor in Cameroon. We do not sell land - we verify, secure and accompany your land acquisition project.

items.q: How do I buy land from abroad?
items.a: Contact us on WhatsApp (+33 7 45 90 98 56) or by email (contact@kambriq.com). A certified KAMNET™ agent guides you from land selection through to obtaining your title deed.
It is the only document that proves you own a piece of land in Cameroon. It is issued by the State, numbered, and recorded in an official land registry.

This is the land category that covers more than 95% of Cameroonian territory. On the national domain, no one is an owner - not even the seller. To become an owner you must go through the land registration process.

items.q: What do the KAMBRIQ TFL™, VEFL™ and VEFIL™ labels mean?
items.a: These are KAMBRIQ's 3 security levels: KAMBRIQ TFL™ (land registration and subdivision complete - immediate ownership at purchase), KAMBRIQ VEFL™ (the title deed exists, subdivision is in progress - ownership transfers once subdivision is complete), KAMBRIQ VEFIL™ (land registration in progress, subdivision to follow - longest of the three processes, higher risk, reinforced support).
Our land verification service. 7 control points per land. €99 for external verification, free if you buy through KAMBRIQ.

items.q: How do I become a KAMNET™ agent?
items.a: By completing the KCA certification through KAMBRIQ Business School (KBS). Online training, final exam (minimum score 80%), numbered certificate valid for 2 years. See the KBS page to learn more.
No. KAMBRIQ is a land strategy advisor. We do not own the lands. Our role is to verify, secure and accompany.

These are new land documents introduced by the Ministry of State Property, Surveys and Land Tenure (MINDCAF) in 2026. The ARDFC (Certificate of Recognition of Customary Land Rights) and the AJPTER (Certificate of Peaceful Land Enjoyment) are preliminary evidence of occupation, NOT title deeds. They concern the 1st-category national domain only.

tfl.name: KAMBRIQ TFL™ - Titre Foncier Loti
tfl.description: Registration is complete and subdivision is done. Ownership is transferred immediately.

advantages.client: You become the owner upon notarial signature. No additional administrative procedures.
advantages.agent: Fast commission, simplified process, secured client.
advantages.commitment: Authentic title deed verified by KAMBRIQ VERIFY™, cadastral compliance confirmed.

vefl.name: KAMBRIQ VEFL™ - Vente en État Futur de Lotissement
vefl.description: Registration is complete - the land title exists. Subdivision is in progress. Ownership is transferred after subdivision is complete.

advantages.client: The existing title deed secures your purchase. You will receive an individual title once subdivision is complete. Shorter timelines than VEFIL™.
advantages.commitment: Title deed verified by KAMBRIQ VERIFY™, approved subdivision plan, KAMBRIQ milestone tracking.

vefil.name: KAMBRIQ VEFIL™ - Vente en État Futur d'Immatriculation et de Lotissement
vefil.description: The land is still undergoing registration. Subdivision will follow. Ownership is transferred after both registration and subdivision are complete. This is the longest process.

advantages.client: You are NOT the owner upon signing. You must wait for both land registration AND subdivision to complete. More attractive price, higher risk.
advantages.agent: Long-term accompaniment, strong client retention potential.
advantages.commitment: Additional verification milestones required by KAMBRIQ. Full monitoring of the registration process.

home.title: KAMBRIQ - Verified and guided land in Cameroon
home.description: KAMBRIQ guides the diaspora through land projects in Cameroon. 7 verifications, 3 security levels, end-to-end support.

methode.title: Our method - KAMBRIQ
methode.description: KAMBRIQ verifies every plot through 7 checkpoints before listing. Discover our method and 3 security levels: TFL™, VEFL™, VEFIL™.

verify.title: KAMBRIQ VERIFY™ - Land verification in Cameroon
verify.description: Verify the authenticity of a plot in Cameroon before any purchase. 7 checkpoints, detailed report. €99 or free when buying through KAMBRIQ.

lands.title: KAMBRIQ LANDS™ - Verified land in Cameroon
lands.description: KAMBRIQ LANDS™ offers land in Cameroon verified through 7 checkpoints. 3 security labels (TFL™, VEFL™, VEFIL™). Full support by a certified agent.

plan.title: KAMBRIQ PLAN™ - Instalment payments for land in Cameroon
plan.description: Buy land in Cameroon with instalment payments. 5% deposit, schedule based on your budget. End-to-end KAMBRIQ support.

kbs.title: KAMBRIQ Business School - Land agent training Cameroon
kbs.description: Train in Cameroon land law and become a certified KAMNET™ agent. KCA programme, online training, recognised certification.

kamnet.title: KAMNET™ - Certified KAMBRIQ land agent network
kamnet.description: KAMNET™ is the network of KAMBRIQ-certified agents. Trained by KBS, they guide the diaspora through land projects in Cameroon.
